definition: someone who buys and sells goods
description: A crowded antiques warehouse with high wooden beams. A young woman in a tweed jacket and tall boots stands on an old armchair balanced on a suitcase on top of a wooden wardrobe, holding a crystal chandelier that throws sparks at its fitting and reaching out with her other hand, then smiles down. A young man in dungarees steadies the wardrobe and a man in a camel coat looks up and spreads his hands. Grandfather clocks, rolled rugs, lamps and stuffed birds under glass domes fill the room, and pigeons fly under the roof.
